title: End Rtp
description: Teleport players to random safe locations when entering the End.
body:
# **EndRtp**

### **Overview**

EndRtp is a lightweight and highly configurable Paper plugin that distributes players across the main End island instead of spawning everyone at the default End platform.

During End Fight events or on large survival servers, dozens of players can enter the End at the same time. Vanilla Minecraft always places them on the same obsidian platform, creating congestion, PvP issues, and unnecessary server lag.

EndRtp solves this by teleporting each player to a random safe location around the End island as soon as they enter through an End Portal.

The result is a smoother, fairer, and more optimized End experience.


---

### **Features**

Random End spawn locations

Safe location detection

Avoid spawning in dangerous blocks

Configurable minimum and maximum spawn radius

Configurable maximum search attempts

Bypass permission support

Fully customizable messages

Chat & ActionBar events

Success / Failed / Bypass event system

Execute console or player commands

Enable / Disable plugin instantly

Lightweight and optimized

Clean and fully commented configuration

Performance-friendly implementation



---

### **Why EndRtp?**

Vanilla End spawning has several issues:

Every player spawns in the exact same location.

Large End fights create heavy player congestion.

PvP becomes chaotic immediately.

Large groups increase server lag around the platform.

Players can accidentally push each other into the void.


EndRtp completely removes these problems by distributing players safely around the island.


---

### **Configuration**

Everything can be customized.

Spawn distance

Dangerous blocks

Maximum search attempts

Enable / Disable

Success events

Failed events

Bypass events

Chat messages

ActionBar messages

Console commands

Player commands


No code editing required.


---

### **Permissions**

endrtp.use

endrtp.bypass

endrtp.reload

endrtp.info

endrtp.help

endrtp.admin


---

### **Performance**

EndRtp performs location calculations only when a player enters the End.

There are:

No scheduled tasks

No repeating timers

No unnecessary chunk scanning

No constant background processing


The plugin is designed to have virtually no performance impact during normal gameplay.


---

### **Perfect For**

Survival Servers

SMP Networks

Hardcore Servers

Lifesteal Servers

Public Servers

End Fight Events
